decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The walls of the outbuilding shall be pebbledashed.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 26 	Bulstrode Gardens.	It shall not be used for living accommodation or any commercial use.
description: Retention of single storey store/shed in rear end of garden to dwellinghouse.
